messages.author: Ifeoma Okonkwo
messages.text: Before I go: the travel workbook v3 is current — v2 predates the June commitments. Headroom is approved minus committed minus reserved; the 900 pending on ADJ-2200 and the 400 Quayside deposit are reserved.

messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Siobhán and Marcus are on basic fares — those are forfeited, new tickets at 290. The four Bristol flex fares and Camille's re-issue for their recorded fees. Standard queue unless someone approves rush.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: AP-DK-0102 is an adjustment up to 1,500 on the travel line, standard queue only. Anything on the rush queue is Rui's call; anything above the line ceiling or a reclass is Ifeoma's.
